sentences.text:
Mr. Ananda Basu,
 Mr. D. Bharua,
 Ms. Pooja Sah

....  For the petitioner  1.
Present petition has been filed for quashing of G.R. Case No. 62 of 2024 corresponding to Bidhan Nagar Women Police Station case No. 02 of 2024 under Section 376/417 of the Indian Penal Code 1860.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the facts of the case are that consensual relationship which did not succeed.

Learned counsel has also pointed out that contradiction in the FIR and the statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C..
3. Issue notice to the State of West Bengal through the office of the learned Public Prosecutor and the opposite party No. 2/defacto complainant be also served.
4. Affidavit of service be filed.
5. Since there are some material contradiction let the proceedings in G.R. Case No. 62 of 2024 shall remain stayed till 27th February, 2026.

6. List this matter in the combined Monthly List of February, 2026.
(Dinesh Kumar Sharma, J.)
